origin: Original practice stimulus; reviewed axis/unit derivation

data.unit_rule: Vertical-axis unit divided by horizontal-axis unit; angle/count ratios may be dimensionless.
data.model_limit: Idealised practice data only. Do not infer that every real dataset is exact, that every line passes through the origin, or that the gradient is automatically a familiar constant.

gradient_meaning: The slope is liquid-column length change per temperature degree for this apparatus, 0.6 mm/°C. It is not a volume-expansion coefficient.
aim: measure a liquid column’s response to bath temperature
arrangement: An open safe-liquid bulb and uniform narrow tube with a fixed length-reference mark, stirred water bath, reference thermometer and millimetre rule
